notes: 02: no metadata fetching on save (no title/description/favicon/preview collection). 03: title is manually editable before/after save, but no auto-collection and no separate description field. 06: duplicate url still creates a new bookmark (returns duplicate:true and a warning) rather than converging to edit the existing one; does not prevent duplicates. 07: list shows title/url/notes/tags but no favicon. 10: tags entered via plain text input, no existing-tag autocomplete/datalist. 14: no #tag search syntax parsing; q is plain substring. 15: no AND/OR/NOT operators or parenthesized groups. 16: no quoted-phrase exact match. 17-19: no unread/read state (no field or UI). 20: no multi-select bulk actions. 21: no filter-scoped bulk action. 22: fixed created_at DESC ordering, no sort-key selection. 23: notes stored and displayed but as plain textContent, not rendered as markdown. 24-25: no snapshot (local HTML/PDF or Internet Archive). 26-28: no archive concept (no field, no archived list). 29: no bundles/saved filters. 30-31: no Netscape HTML import/export. 32: no user display settings (sort/items/font size).
